source_revision.qualification: Stage 4b completion includes the documented local adapter and deterministic-normalization fixes; this attestation is not clean-commit reproducibility evidence.

recovery_disclosure.defect: CodexExecResult freezes its top-level structured output as MappingProxyType, while the configured jsonschema object checker expected a concrete dict at the post-dispatch resource-validation boundary.
recovery_disclosure.local_fix: Thaw the already structured top-level result with dict(invoked.output) before resource-schema validation, then replay local validation, normalization, publication, and verification.

normalization.reason: Claims reused across report sections were deterministically materialized as section-local stable claims; the evidence-free procedural references note was replaced by the coordinator-owned canonical note and was not entered into the research-claim ledger.

recovery_disclosure.qualification: The recovered-* value is a local surrogate ledger identity, not the unavailable provider invocation ID. The persisted structured output was reused and Sol was not called again.
